exposure: Delivery mode (elective cesarean, operative vaginal, etc.)
finding: There was a significant association between PPD and the type of delivery, with elective cesarean section and operative vaginal delivery being associated with PPD symptoms, but no significant association was found between PPD and passive smoking or ABO blood groups.
mod_finding: A significant association was found between PPD and the type of delivery, with elective cesarean section and operative vaginal delivery being associated with PPD symptoms.
cross-section timing: within six weeks of giving birth
